note: The Lumi marker grammar: the ONE machine-readable definition of every [[aura:...]] line. Python (engine/aura_markers.py) loads this file; the browser (engine/form/js/markers.js) carries a copy that tools/form-dev/test_instructions.py asserts is identical, and both parsers are run against tools/form-dev/marker_cases.json. The prose version for Claude is the 'App markers' section of .claude/skills/aura-slide/SKILL.md.
line: A marker is ONE whole line: [[aura:<name>]] , [[aura:<name>=<value>]] or [[aura:<name> key=value key="value" ...]]. Leading/trailing spaces are fine; any other text on the line makes it 'not-alone'. A value is "double quoted" (no quote, line break or ]] inside) or a bare token of letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Attribute order is free; a repeated attribute: the last one wins.

stage.emittedBy: Claude (progress, SKILL.md steps, planning, building, editing)
stage.consumedBy: browser: workshop.js (progress bar, scenes), editor.js (status line); server: none

ask.emittedBy: Claude, last line of a turn that waits for the person (build questions, editor questions, the first-build flow; never while planning)
ask.consumedBy: server: Runner (waiting / asked, blocks the next build step); browser: workshop.js, scenes

done.emittedBy: Claude, last line when a deck is built or changed
done.consumedBy: server: Runner._deck_from (which file is the deck); browser: workshop.js, scenes (finished state)

choice.emittedBy: Claude: build-time design questions, editor questions, planning doubts
choice.consumedBy: browser: markers.js choiceCard (build popup, editor chat); server: parse_doubts (planning doubts shown on the plan page)

text.emittedBy: Claude: an interview question (or any question) whose answer space is open, so a list of options would be a lie
text.consumedBy: browser: markers.js choiceCard (one textarea instead of option buttons); server: ingest_interview (the open question kept in interview.json). LIMIT: when/depends may only reference a `choice` question - a text answer is seen as nothing selected, so a condition on a text question never holds.

interview-done.emittedBy: Claude, last line of the interview turn that has no doubt left which would change a slide (interview.json must already say done:true)
interview-done.consumedBy: server: ingest_interview (the interview is finished; the deck moves on to the theme and the plan)

hint.emittedBy: Claude, 3-5 after a build or edit (1-3 per built slide in the build flow)
hint.consumedBy: browser: workshop.js suggestion chips; server: none

plan.emittedBy: Claude, very last line of a planning run ([plan-mode], [plan-edit])
plan.consumedBy: server: after_run -> ingest_plan (the path is informational: the plan is always .aura/decks/<id>/plan.json)

plan-ok.emittedBy: Claude, one per re-planned slide that raises no doubt ([plan-edit])
plan-ok.consumedBy: server: ingest_plan (the slide's pill turns 'all clear')

built.emittedBy: Claude, second-to-last line of a [build-slide] step (before done)
built.consumedBy: server: after_run (marks the slide built, unlocks the next step)
